[\ud83d\ude4f Acknowledgements](#-acknowledgements)\n- [\ud83d\udcc4 License](#-license)\n\n## \ud83e\udd14 What is Spec-Driven Development?\n\nSpec-Driven Development **flips the script** on traditional software development. Use ccpm any time the user is talking about shipping a feature, managing work, or tracking progress — even if they don't say 'ccpm' or 'PRD'. Do NOT use for: debugging code, writing tests, reviewing PRs, or raw GitHub issue/PR operations with no delivery context."
